title: Cash Pickup Collection Window, Reactivation and Expiry Refund Schedule
content:
**Schedule to the Cash Pickup service terms.**

- **Pickup window:** the calendar days, counted from the date the money became available, during which the cash can be collected.
- **Reactivation window:** the calendar days after expiry during which an expired pickup can be reactivated. A figure of 0 means no reactivation.
- **Reactivation fee:** the fee charged for each reactivation.
- **Most reactivations:** the largest number of reactivations allowed on one transfer.
- **Expiry fee refund:** the share of the transfer fee refunded when an expired transfer is refunded.

| Cash Pickup tier | Pickup window (calendar days) | Reactivation window (calendar days after expiry) | Reactivation fee (USD) | Most reactivations per transfer | Transfer fee refunded on an expired transfer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 30 | 30 | 4.99 | 1 | 0 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 30 | 30 | 4.99 | 1 | 0 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 45 | 45 | 0.00 | 2 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 30 | 30 | 4.99 | 1 | 0 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 7 | 0 (no reactivation) | 0.00 | 0 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 15 | 15 | 9.99 | 1 | 0 |

## Comparing the tiers

- Cash Pickup Cardless ATM has the shortest window, 7 days, and allows no reactivation at all. Both its reactivation window and its most-reactivations figure are 0.
- Cash Pickup Express Plus has the longest window, 45 days. It allows up to 2 reactivations with a listed fee of 0.00 and refunds 100 percent of the transfer fee on an expired transfer.
- Cash Pickup Large Amount has a 15-day window and the highest listed reactivation fee, 9.99.
